headline: Adopted revised Ends Policy, approved bid for campus salting truck and accounts payable checks, and named a merger committee member.
summary: The meeting covered the Ends Policy, the Act 170 merger committee, the Fiscal Year 2028 budget approach, and student programs. Residents commented on a Center for Technology Essex presentation, staffing and pay, and health literacy. The board also postponed Monitoring Report 2.3 to October 21 and approved a consent agenda.
decisions: Adopted the new Ends Policy with the edits made during the meeting; passed with all in favor.
Postponed Monitoring Report 2.3 Treatment of Community to October 21, with the Superintendent to prepare it.
Named Michelle Boyer as the third board member to the Act 170 Merger Committee; passed unanimously.
Named Elissa Galvez as an alternate member of the Act 170 Merger Committee; passed with all in favor.
Approved the bid for a Ford F550 Super Duty campus salting vehicle; passed with all in favor.
Approved accounts payable voucher checks; passed with all in favor.
Approved the consent agenda, including September 16, 2026 meeting minutes, accounts payable orders, payroll warrants, and the salting vehicle bid.

decision_evidence.quote: Seamus Abshere called for a motion to adopt the new Ends Policy as provided in the Board packet with the edits made during the meeting. Dan Boyer moved; Tom Chittenden seconded the motion. All were in favor; the motion passed.
The Board postponed it to October 21, deciding the Superintendent should prepare it rather than the Board.

Seamus Abshere called for a motion to nominate Michelle Boyer as the third board member for the committee. Jennifer Lawrence moved and Emilee Hoffman seconded the motion. All were in favor; motion passed unanimously.
Seamus Abshere called for a motion to nominate Elissa Galvez as an alternate member. Tom Chittenden moved and Michelle Boyer seconded the motion. All were in favor and the motion passed.

Seamus Abshere called for a motion to approve the bid for the Ford F550 Super Duty campus salting vehicle. Michelle Boyer moved and Elissa Galvez seconded the motion. All were in favor; motion passed.
Seamus Abshere called for a motion to approve the AP voucher checks. Tom Chittenden moved and Elissa Galvez seconded the motion. All were in favor; motion passed.
Seamus Abshere asked if there were any objections to the Consent Agenda. Hearing none, the agenda passed by consent.

decision_titles: Michelle Boyer as third member of Act 170 Merger Committee
Elissa Galvez as alternate on Act 170 Merger Committee
Bid for Ford F550 Super Duty campus salting vehicle
